title: Eucommia lignans alleviate the progression of diabetic nephropathy through mediating the AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK axis in vivo and in vitro.
authors: Huang, Qi; Zhang, Yinfan; Jiang, Yueping; Huang, Ling; Liu, Qiong; Ouyang, Dongsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杜仲木脂素通过AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK轴缓解糖尿病肾病，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lignans derived from Eucommia ulmoides Oliver (Eucommia lignans) inhibit the progression of inflammatory diseases, while their effect on the progression of diabetic nephropathy (DN) remained unclear. This work was designed to assess the function of Eucommia lignans in DN. The major constituents of Eucommia lignans were analyzed by UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS. The binding between Eucommia lignans and aldose reductase (AR) was predicted by molecular docking. Eucommia lignans (200, 100, and 50 mg.kg(-1)) were used in model animals to evaluate their renal function changes. Rat glomerular mesangial cells (HBZY-1) were transfected with sh-AR, sh-AMPK, and oe-AR in the presence of high glucose (HG) or HG combined with Eucommia lignans to evaluate whether Eucommia lignans affected HG-induced cell injury and mitochondrial dysfunction through the AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK axis. Eucommia lignans significantly attenuated the progression of DN in vivo. Eucommia lignans notably reversed HG-induced upregulation of inflammatory cytokines and mitochondrial injury, while downregulating the levels of Cyto c, caspase 9, AR, and NOX4 in HBZY-1 cells. In contrast, HG-induced downregulation of Nrf2, HO-1 and p-AMPKalpha levels were abolished by Eucommia lignans. Meanwhile, knockdown of AR exerted similar therapeutic effect of Eucommia lignans on DN progression, and AR overexpression reversed the effect of Eucommia lignans. Eucommia lignans alleviated renal injury through the AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK axis. Thus, these findings might provide evidence for the use of Eucommia lignans in treating DN.
abstract_zh: 来源于杜仲（Eucommia ulmoides Oliver）的木脂素（Eucommia lignans）可抑制炎症性疾病的进展，但其对糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy, DN）进展的影响尚不清楚。本研究旨在评估杜仲木脂素在DN中的作用。通过UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS分析杜仲木脂素的主要成分，并利用分子对接（molecular docking）预测杜仲木脂素与醛糖还原酶（aldose reductase, AR）之间的结合。在模型动物中给予杜仲木脂素（200、100和50 mg.kg(-1)），以评估其肾功能变化。大鼠肾小球系膜细胞（HBZY-1）在高糖（high glucose, HG）或HG联合杜仲木脂素条件下，转染sh-AR、sh-AMPK和oe-AR，以评估杜仲木脂素是否通过AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK轴影响HG诱导的细胞损伤和线粒体功能障碍。杜仲木脂素在体内显著减缓了DN的进展。杜仲木脂素显著逆转了HG诱导的炎症细胞因子上调及线粒体损伤，同时下调HBZY-1细胞中Cyto c、caspase 9、AR和NOX4的水平。相反，HG诱导的Nrf2、HO-1和p-AMPKalpha水平下调被杜仲木脂素所消除。同时，AR敲低对DN进展表现出与杜仲木脂素相似的治疗效果，而AR过表达则逆转了杜仲木脂素的作用。杜仲木脂素通过AR/Nrf2/HO-1/AMPK轴减轻肾损伤。因此，这些发现可能为杜仲木脂素治疗DN提供证据。
